M: Hal Tucker's maple mustard chicken with charred corn
Hal's still not talking to Gabe, but he'll share the skillet

Chicken thighs glazed with maple syrup and wholegrain mustard in a cast iron pan, with corn charred over the coals and a squeeze of lime. Mix the maple syrup, mustard, garlic and oil and coat the chicken. Grill or pan-fry the chicken over medium heat, turning and brushing with the glaze, until sticky and cooked through. Char the corn over the coals or in a hot pan, turning, until blackened in spots. Rub the corn with butter and lime and serve with the chicken.
Rosemary rump steaks grilled over coals, potatoes baked in foil
Rump steak rubbed with salt, pepper and rosemary, grilled over hot coals 4 minutes a side, rested on a board. Potatoes wrapped in foil with butter and baked in the coals for 45 minutes.
Chicken thigh curry in a tomato and coconut milk sauce
Chicken thighs cooked with onion, ginger, garlic and curry spices, tomato and coconut milk, simmered 40 minutes, with rice and mango chutney.
Treehouse river fish and coconut stew
Caught off the waterfall below the treehouse

Firm white fish simmered in coconut milk with tomato, ginger, chilli and spinach, over rice with lime. Soften the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli in the oil. Add the tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer. Meanwhile steam the rice. Add the fish and simmer gently until just cooked. Stir through the spinach and lime juice and serve over rice.
700g firm white fish fillets, in chunks@Seafood

S: Rye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and capers
Rye crispbread spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, dill and capers, finished with lemon.
Crab, cream cheese and spring onion baked until golden and bubbling
Crab meat mixed with cream cheese, mayo and spring onion, baked at 190C for 20 minutes until golden, with crackers.
Ramone's general store reindeer sausage rolls
Ramone runs the store, the bar and the wedding

Smoky reindeer-style sausage meat with onion and sage in flaky puff pastry, with hot mustard. Heat the oven to 200°C. Mix the sausage meat with the onion, sage and paprika. Pipe or roll the mix along each pastry sheet, roll up and brush with beaten egg. Cut into pieces and bake until puffed and golden. Serve hot with mustard.

M: Teriyaki chicken thigh skewers, grilled and basted, with steamed rice
Chicken thigh skewers marinated in teriyaki, ginger and garlic, grilled and served with rice and sesame.
A big hunk of meat on the bone, eaten with both hands

Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow-roasted until they pull from the bone, glazed with barbecue sauce, with a crunchy slaw. Heat the oven to 160°C. Rub the ribs with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Put the ribs in a deep tray with the stock, cover tightly with foil and roast until tender. Brush with barbecue sauce and roast uncovered until sticky. Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise and vinegar and serve with the ribs.

S: Rye crispbread with cream cheese, smoked salmon, dill and lemon
Rye crispbread spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, dill and a squeeze of lemon, laid out on a wooden board.
Tanana's wild greens and roast beetroot salad
Tanana sends Kenai off with something green

Roast beetroot with peppery leaves, goat's cheese, toasted pepitas and a maple vinegar dressing. Heat the oven to 200°C. Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast until tender. Toast the pepitas in a dry pan. Peel and cut the beetroot into wedges. Whisk the maple syrup, vinegar and oil. Toss the leaves and beetroot with the dressing and top with goat's cheese and pepitas.
Pecans and walnuts roasted in maple syrup with a pinch of salt
Pecans and walnuts tossed with maple syrup and salt, roasted at 170C for 12 minutes and cooled into clusters.

M: Mama Boucher's chicken and sausage gumbo
Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra, over rice

A dark roux gumbo of chicken thigh, smoked sausage, okra and the holy trinity, ladled over steamed rice with spring onion and hot sauce. Stir 80g plain flour into 80ml oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat for 20 minutes until it turns dark brown like chocolate. Add 1 diced onion, 2 celery sticks and 1 green capsicum and cook 5 minutes. Add 600g diced chicken thigh, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun seasoning and 1.2L chicken stock, and simmer 1 hour. Add 200g sliced okra for 10 minutes. Serve over 300g steamed long grain rice with sliced spring onion and hot sauce.
Vicki Vallencourt's blackened catfish po' boys
Vicki's been to prison twice, she knows a good sandwich

Catfish fillets rubbed with Cajun spice and blackened in a hot pan, in soft rolls with shredded lettuce, tomato, pickles and remoulade. Mix the mayonnaise, mustard, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon for the remoulade. Coat the fish in the Cajun seasoning. Melt the butter in a very hot pan and cook the fish until blackened and just cooked. Split the rolls, spread with remoulade and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickles and fish.
Big rump steak with garlic butter, onion rings, roast potatoes, ranch wedge

A huge chargrilled rump sliced to share, with garlic butter, crispy roast potatoes, onion rings and a wedge salad with ranch. Rub a 1.5kg piece of rump steak with oil and salt. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and roast at 220C for 40 minutes. Grill the steak over high heat for 8 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest 10 minutes. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves. Bake 400g frozen onion rings for 15 minutes. Cut 1 iceberg lettuce into wedges and drizzle with ranch. Slice the steak thickly, pour over the garlic butter and serve.
Roman's big shot barbecue chicken with potato salad
Roman insists on paying, then tells you what it cost

Chicken marylands brushed with smoky barbecue sauce and grilled over the coals, with a creamy dill potato salad. Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and cool a little. Toss the potatoes with the mayonnaise, sour cream, spring onion, chopped dill and salt. Rub the chicken with paprika and salt and grill over medium coals, turning, until nearly cooked. Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky. Serve with the potato salad.
brought up from the cellar, whatever else is down there

Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and crush lightly with a fork and half the butter. Season the chops with the salt and pepper and sear in the oil for 4 minutes a side until just cooked. Rest on a plate. Fry the apples, onion and sage in the rest of the butter until golden. Add 250ml chicken stock and the mustard, bubble to reduce by half, then stir in the cream. Return the chops and their juices to warm through and serve with the potatoes.
Annie Knowby's apple-braised chicken with root vegetables
Annie turns up with the missing pages and a proper dinner

Chicken thighs browned and braised with apple juice, thyme, carrots, parsnips and onion until tender, with crusty bread for the sauce. Brown the chicken skin side down in the oil in a heavy pot, then set aside. Add the onion, carrot and parsnip and colour lightly. Add the apple, apple juice, stock and thyme, put the chicken back on top and simmer covered. Uncover and simmer until the sauce reduces. Serve with crusty bread.
the first lunch the new camp cook was hired to make
Beef mince simmered in a sweet and tangy tomato sauce with onion and green capsicum, piled into toasted soft rolls with pickles.
Steve Christy's opening week cookout chicken
Steve's back from town with supplies before the storm

Chicken thighs in a lemon, garlic and oregano marinade grilled over the coals, with potato salad and a green salad. Marinate the chicken in the juice of 1 lemon, the garlic, oregano and 2 tbsp oil. Boil the potatoes until tender, cool a little and toss with the mayonnaise and spring onion. Grill the chicken over the coals until charred and cooked through. Dress the cos with the last of the oil and lemon and serve with the chicken and potatoes.
Saucy beef mince with cheddar and pickles on slider buns

Saucy beef mince cooked down with capsicum, onion, tomato and brown sugar, piled into toasted slider buns with cheddar and crunchy pickles. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 8 minutes. Add 2 garlic cloves, 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp mustard and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Toast 12 slider buns, add a slice of cheddar to each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced pickles.
Andy's Camp Tigerclaw game day fried chicken
Fuel for the softball game against Camp Tigerclaw

Buttermilk-soaked chicken tenders in a spiced flour crust, shallow fried, with tangy slaw and pickles. Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with a pinch of salt. Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt and toss the chicken through it. Shallow fry in batches in hot oil until golden and cooked through. Toss the cabbage with the mayonnaise and vinegar and serve with the chicken and pickles.
Two smashed beef patties, cheese and pickle sauce, with paprika fries

Two thin smashed patties with melted cheese, onion, pickles and a tangy burger sauce in toasted buns, with crunchy seasoned fries. Bake 750g frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with salt and paprika. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and chopped pickles. Toast 4 buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties with diced onion and pickles.
Gayle's Sturdy Wings vegetable chilli with cornbread
Gayle runs Sturdy Wings on second chances and big pots

Black beans, kidney beans, capsicum and sweet potato simmered with chilli and cumin, with sour cream, cheddar and warm cornbread. Soften the onion, garlic and capsicum in the oil. Add the sweet potato, cumin and chilli powder and cook for a minute. Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer until the sweet potato is soft. Meanwhile bake the cornbread to the packet directions. Serve with sour cream, cheddar and warm cornbread.
Light horse camp beef and stout stew
Chuck beef, carrot and onion slow-cooked in stout

Chuck steak slow-braised with stout, onion, carrot and thyme until falling apart, with buttery mash to soak up the gravy. Toss 1kg diced chuck in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in oil. Add 2 diced onions, 3 carrots and 2 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 375ml stout, 500ml beef stock, thyme and 2 bay leaves. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Spoon the stew over the mash.
Dave Mitchell's Beersheba lamb and date pilaf
Rice from the Bedouin traders on the road to Beersheba

Lamb shoulder simmered with cumin, cinnamon and onion, then cooked through rice with dates, finished with toasted almonds and parsley. Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot, add the onion and cook until soft. Add the cumin, cinnamon and 500ml stock and simmer covered until the lamb is tender. Stir in the rice, dates and the rest of the stock, cover and cook on low until the rice is done. Toast the almonds and scatter over with chopped parsley.
Crusty potato and corned beef hash topped with a fried egg

Crispy pan-fried corned beef and potato hash with onion and Worcestershire, topped with runny fried eggs and a dollop of brown sauce. Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes and drain well. Fry 1 diced onion in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add the potatoes and 400g diced corned beef and press flat. Cook over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning in sections, until crusty. Splash with 1 tbsp Worcestershire and add chopped parsley. Fry 4 eggs and sit one on each serve with brown sauce.
Armentières estaminet chicken and leek pie
The café behind the lines where the tunnellers spend their pay

Chicken and leeks in a creamy thyme sauce under a puff pastry lid, with buttered peas. Brown the chicken in half the butter, then add the leeks and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and thyme and simmer until thick. Cool a little. Heat the oven to 200°C. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with pastry and brush with beaten egg. Bake until puffed and golden. Boil the peas and toss with the rest of the butter.
Pan-fried crab cakes with paprika chips and slaw

Maryland-style crab cakes seasoned with celery salt and paprika, seared golden and served with crunchy slaw, lemon and spiced chips. Mix 500g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp celery salt, 1/2 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and 60g panko. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Fry in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side. Bake 800g frozen chips and toss with paprika salt. Toss shredded cabbage with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and vinegar. Serve with lemon wedges.
Ridgewood Ranch tri-tip with beans and cornbread
Charles Howard's ranch, where Seabiscuit learns to run again

Beef tri-tip rubbed with garlic, pepper and paprika, grilled and sliced thin, with smoky pinto beans and buttered cornbread. Rub the beef with the garlic powder, paprika, pepper and salt. Soften the onion in the oil, add the beans, tomatoes and sugar and simmer. Meanwhile bake the cornbread to the packet directions. Grill the beef over medium heat, turning, until medium rare, then rest. Slice thin across the grain and serve with the beans and buttered cornbread.
Haywood Ranch grilled tri-tip and beans
Rump cap grilled over coals and sliced, with warm pinto beans

Tri-tip or rump cap rubbed with salt, pepper and garlic, grilled over coals, rested and sliced, with pinto beans and fresh salsa. Rub a 1.2kg rump cap with salt, pepper and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Grill over coals, fat side first, until 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Warm 2 tins pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion, coriander and lime for salsa. Slice and serve.
Angel's night shift chicken tinga burritos
Angel from Fry's brings dinner for the long watch on the clouds

Chicken simmered in a smoky chipotle tomato sauce, rolled in flour tortillas with rice, black beans, cheese and lettuce. Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the chipotle, tomatoes and chicken and simmer until tender. Meanwhile cook the rice. Shred the chicken into the sauce and cook until thick. Warm the beans and tortillas. Fill the tortillas with rice, beans, chicken, cheese and lettuce and roll up tight.

S: Soft baked pretzels with rock salt, grainy mustard and butter
Pretzel dough proved, shaped, dipped in hot bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with grainy mustard and butter.
Beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and smoked paprika, dried overnight
Beef topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and smoked paprika overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
Schultz's winter camp pumpkin and lentil soup
The snowbound winter Django learns the bounty trade

Roast pumpkin and red lentils simmered with onion, cumin and stock, with buttered rye bread for dunking. Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin. Add the pumpkin, lentils and stock and simmer until soft. Blitz until smooth and season. Serve with buttered rye bread.
Toasted rye topped with pastrami, sauerkraut and melted Swiss cheese

Rye bread squares stacked with pastrami, sauerkraut and Swiss, toasted until the cheese melts, with a dab of Russian dressing and a pickle on a pick. Cut 6 slices of rye bread into quarters and toast lightly at 200C for 4 minutes. Top each with folded pastrami from 250g, a little drained sauerkraut from 150g and a square of Swiss cheese from 150g. Bake 5 minutes until melted. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish and chopped pickle. Dab on each bite and spear with a slice of dill pickle.
Pan-fried pork and garlic chive dumplings with black vinegar
Pork, garlic chives, ginger and sesame oil folded into wrappers, pan-fried until crisp underneath, then steamed. Black vinegar dip.
For Danny, Nancy's little brother, who keeps an eye on the store

Fluffy steamed buns filled with chicken, shiitake and spring onion in oyster sauce. Mix the chicken, shiitake, spring onion, ginger, oyster sauce, soy and sesame oil. Stir-fry the filling until cooked and sticky. Open the bao and spoon in the filling. Steam until hot through.
6 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and chopped@Pantry

M: Barbecue glazed chicken thighs with mac and cheese and silverbeet
Barbecue chicken thighs with mac and cheese and greens, the family dinner James gets invited to.
James King's Bel Air steak frites
The last fancy dinner King thinks he's getting before San Quentin

Sirloin steaks seared hard and finished with garlic herb butter, with crisp oven fries and a dressed rocket salad. Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chips in 2 tbsp oil and salt and bake, turning once, until crisp. Mash the butter with the garlic and chopped parsley. Sear the steaks in a very hot pan to your liking, then rest with a slice of herb butter on each. Dress the rocket with lemon and the last of the oil and serve with the steak and chips.
Gloucester chicken, leek and bacon pie
Creamy chicken, leek and bacon filling under a pastry lid

Chicken thigh, leek, bacon and carrot in a creamy thyme sauce under golden puff pastry, with buttered peas on the side. Fry 3 diced rashers bacon, then add 800g diced chicken thigh and brown. Add 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced carrots and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 3 tbsp plain flour, then 400ml chicken stock and 150ml cream and simmer 15 minutes with thyme. Pour into a pie dish, top with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 300g buttered peas.
Thomas and Bea's Lake District kitchen, with no rabbits allowed

Lamb, onion and carrot slow-cooked under a lid of sliced potatoes that bake golden and crisp, with buttered garden peas. Heat the oven to 170°C. Toss the lamb in the flour and brown in a casserole dish. Add the onion, carrot, stock, Worcestershire and thyme and bring to a simmer. Lay the potato slices over the top, dot with half the butter, cover and bake. Uncover and bake until the potatoes are golden and crisp. Boil the peas and toss with the rest of the butter.
the classic Hollywood lunch, chopped and laid out in rows
Chopped cos lettuce with poached chicken, crisp bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese in neat rows, with a red wine vinaigrette.
The LA lunch the crew line up for between takes on Stab 3

Thin-sliced roast beef piled into crusty rolls with Swiss cheese and hot mustard, with a cup of beef jus for dipping. Cook the onion in the butter until soft and golden. Add the stock and Worcestershire and simmer to make the jus. Warm the beef in a little jus, then pile into the rolls with the cheese and onion and grill until melted. Spread with mustard and serve with cups of jus for dipping.
Christmas Eve arroz con pollo for the loft
Dinner for everyone once Angel's drum money comes through
Puerto Rican chicken and yellow rice in one big pot: garlic and lime marinated thighs browned and simmered in sofrito rice with capsicum, green olives and peas, enough to warm a whole cold loft.
Collins' Santa Fe green chilli pork stew
Collins' big plan: leave the city and open a restaurant in Santa Fe

Pork shoulder braised with roasted green chillies, potato, onion and cumin, with warm flour tortillas and lime. Char the chillies and capsicums under the grill, then peel, seed and chop. Brown the pork in the oil in a heavy pot, add the onion, garlic and cumin and cook until soft. Add the chillies, capsicum and stock and simmer covered until the pork is tender. Add the potatoes and simmer until soft. Serve with warm tortillas, lime and coriander.
Grilled beef patties, American cheese, pickle sauce and lettuce

Juicy beef patties with melted American cheese, dill pickles, shredded lettuce and a pickle-flecked burger sauce in toasted sesame buns. Shape 800g beef mince into 4 patties slightly wider than the buns and season well. Grill on a hot barbecue 4 minutes a side, adding 2 slices of American cheese each for the last minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp mustard and 2 tbsp chopped dill pickles. Toast 4 sesame buns, spread with sauce, add shredded lettuce, the patty and sliced pickles.
Rico builds the ramps, Rico grills the fish

Crispy battered fish in warm tortillas with lime slaw, avocado and chipotle mayo. Toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt. Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle. Whisk the flour, paprika and soda water into a batter. Dip the fish in the batter and fry in hot oil until golden. Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, sliced avocado and chipotle mayo, with lime wedges.
600g firm white fish fillets, in strips@Seafood
Thin beef patties steamed over onions with cheddar and pickles

Tiny beef patties steamed on a bed of diced onion, then stacked with cheese and pickles in soft square buns. Press 600g beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into 16 squares. Spread 2 finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes. Add cheese and serve in 16 small soft buns with pickles.
Harold's crispy fish sliders with tartare
Harold's order, once Kumar's done reading out thirty sliders

Crumbed white fish squares on soft slider buns with tartare, cheese and shredded lettuce. Mix the mayonnaise, capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon for the tartare. Dust the fish in flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in panko. Shallow fry until golden and cooked through. Fill the buns with lettuce, fish, cheese and tartare.
600g white fish fillets, cut into squares@Seafood
Drive-through lemon chicken and fried rice
Crispy chicken in lemon sauce, egg fried rice and garlic broccoli

Crisp battered chicken in a glossy fresh lemon sauce, with egg fried rice, peas and spring onion and a side of garlicky stir-fried broccoli. Cook 300g jasmine rice the day before and chill. Cut 700g chicken thigh into strips, dip in 1 beaten egg, then toss in 100g cornflour. Shallow fry at 180C for 5 minutes until crisp. Simmer the juice of 3 lemons, 80g caster sugar, 150ml water and 1 tbsp cornflour until glossy, and pour over. Fry the cold rice in a hot wok with 2 scrambled eggs, 100g peas, 2 tbsp soy and 3 spring onions. Stir-fry 1 head broccoli with 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes.
'And then?' beef and black bean noodles
The drive-through order that never ends: and then, and then, and then

Wok-fried beef with black bean sauce, capsicum and onion over thick egg noodles. Toss the beef with the cornflour and 1 tbsp soy. Stir-fry the beef in half the oil in a very hot wok until browned, then lift out. Stir-fry the onion, capsicum and garlic in the rest of the oil, add the noodles, black bean sauce and the rest of the soy. Toss the beef back through and top with spring onion.
Action hero rib eye with onion rings
Grilled rib eye with garlic parsley butter, battered onion rings

Chargrilled rib eye with garlic herb butter, a stack of crunchy soda-battered onion rings and a peppery rocket salad. Mash 60g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove and chopped parsley. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 250ml cold soda water into a batter. Slice 2 large onions into thick rings, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Season 4 x 300g rib eye steaks and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side for medium rare. Rest 5 minutes, top with the butter and serve with rings and rocket.
Lt. Piper's grilled chicken souvlaki with tzatziki
Piper, the only member of the team who reads the briefing

Lemon oregano chicken grilled on skewers, in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, red onion and chips. Marinate the chicken in the juice of 1 lemon, the oregano, 2 garlic cloves and the oil, then thread onto skewers. Bake the chips to the packet directions. Squeeze the cucumber dry and mix with the yoghurt, the last garlic clove and a squeeze of lemon. Grill the skewers until charred and cooked through. Warm the pita and fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomato, onion and a few chips.
Chicken thighs simmered in stock with vegetables and self-raising dumplings
Chicken thighs simmered with onion, celery, carrot and thyme, shredded back into a creamy broth, fluffy dumplings (self-raising flour, butter, milk) spooned on top and steamed 15 minutes.
Scar comparison sticky beef short ribs
Riggs and Lorna compare scars, you compare sauce

Beef short ribs slow-roasted until they pull from the bone, glazed with a sticky cola barbecue sauce, with buttered corn. Heat the oven to 160°C. Rub the ribs with the sugar, paprika and salt and put in a deep tray with the stock. Cover tightly with foil and roast until tender. Simmer the cola and barbecue sauce until syrupy, brush over the ribs and roast uncovered until sticky. Boil the corn and serve with butter alongside the ribs.
Fine dining fish tacos with pico de gallo
Taco Bell is fine dining now. White tablecloths for the taco course

Lime and chilli grilled snapper in warm corn tortillas with pico de gallo, shredded cabbage and avocado crema. Mix the tomato, onion, chopped coriander and the juice of 1 lime for the pico de gallo. Blitz the avocado with the sour cream and a squeeze of lime for the crema. Rub the fish with the chilli, cumin, oil and salt and grill until just cooked, then flake. Warm the tortillas and fill with cabbage, fish, pico and crema.
Thick seared chuck patties with fried onions and melted cheddar
Big chuck patty seared hard with fried onions, cheddar and barbecue sauce on a toasted bun. Spartan says it's the best burger he's had in years.
S: Boiled conchiglie fried until crisp, tossed in flaky salt and chilli
Shell-shaped pasta (conchiglie) boiled, dried, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in chilli salt. Three per person.
Future fast food chips and salsa
Fried corn tortilla chips with charred tomato jalapeño salsa
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C, salted, with a roasted tomato salsa (charred tomato, onion, garlic and jalapeño blitzed with lime).
W: Three colours of layered jelly cut into neat cubes, with a little whipped cream
Layered jelly: three flavours of jelly set one on top of the other in a slab tin, cut into perfect cubes, served on a white plate.

M: Two smashed beef patties with American cheese, onion, pickles and mustard
Thin smashed patties, American cheese, onion, pickles, mustard and ketchup on a soft toasted bun, 1950s style.
Kenickie's car, the fastest thing at Thunder Road

Buttermilk fried chicken pieces in a paper-lined basket with crinkle-cut chips, coleslaw and a soft dinner roll. Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with salt. Toss in the flour mixed with paprika, garlic powder and salt. Fry in hot oil in batches until golden and cooked through, then hold in a 160°C oven. Bake the chips at the same time. Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise and serve with the chicken, chips and rolls.
Beef and pork meatloaf with tomato glaze, served with mash and peas
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg and onion, tomato glaze, baked at 180C for an hour, mash and peas.
Rockwell, Maine, 1957, where the Giant comes down by the harbour

Lobster tossed in a little mayonnaise, lemon and chives, piled into buttered toasted rolls, with potato chips and a pickle. Chop the lobster and mix with the mayonnaise, celery, a squeeze of lemon and chopped chives. Butter the outside of the rolls and toast in a hot pan until golden. Pile the lobster into the rolls and serve with chips and a pickle.
S: Muffin tin apple pies with cinnamon and a lattice top
Mini apple pies in a muffin tin, shortcrust cases filled with spiced apple, lattice tops, baked at 190C for 25 minutes.
Almond and orange biscotti baked twice until crisp
Dough of flour, sugar, eggs, almonds and orange zest shaped into a log, baked at 170C for 25 minutes, sliced, baked again 10 minutes a side until crisp.
Mashed sardines with lemon and parsley on sourdough toast, sliced radish

Tinned sardines mashed with butter, lemon and parsley, spread on sourdough toast, finished with sliced radish and black pepper. Mash 2 drained tins of sardines with 30g soft butter, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Spread on 8 slices toasted sourdough and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.
Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and onion on slider buns
Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, stacked high on a platter.
W: Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream with sprinkles, wafers and hot fudge
Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream scooped into a big snowy mountain, with sprinkles, wafer biscuits and hot fudge.

Wobbly cubes of orange, raspberry and lime jelly made with real juice, stacked into a castle on a platter with whipped cream turrets. For each colour, soften 4 tsp gelatine in 3 tbsp cold water, then dissolve in 300ml warm juice with 2 tbsp sugar: orange juice, raspberry juice and lime cordial diluted with water. Pour each into its own lined loaf tin and chill 4 hours until firm. Cut into 3cm cubes and stack into a castle on a platter. Pipe whipped cream from 200ml cream on top.

M: Pepperoni, garlic mushroom and mozzarella pizza with chilli oil

A hand-stretched pizza with rich tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and garlic mushrooms, finished with oregano and chilli oil. Divide 750g pizza dough into 2 and stretch each into a 30cm round on oiled trays. Spread each with 100ml pizza sauce. Fry 200g sliced mushrooms with 1 crushed garlic clove in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Top the bases with 300g grated mozzarella, 120g pepperoni and the mushrooms. Bake at 240C for 12 to 14 minutes until blistered. Scatter with dried oregano and drizzle with chilli oil.
Emilio's very, very sneaky baked ziti
Emilio, the butler with the foot, very, very sneaky

Ziti baked with Italian sausage, tomato sugo, ricotta and a blistered mozzarella top, with a rocket salad. Heat the oven to 200°C. Boil the pasta until just short of done and drain. Brown the sausage in the oil, add the onion and garlic, then the passata, and simmer. Toss the pasta with the sauce, layer into a dish with spoonfuls of ricotta and top with mozzarella and parmesan. Bake until bubbling and blistered. Serve with rocket dressed with oil.
Eggs, sausages, bacon, hash browns and baked beans with toast

A big breakfast plate of crispy bacon, pork sausages, fluffy scrambled eggs, hash browns and baked beans with hot buttered toast. Bake 8 frozen hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 pork sausages over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Warm a 420g tin baked beans. Whisk 8 eggs with 60ml milk and salt, then cook in 30g butter over low heat, stirring gently, until just set. Toast 8 slices of bread and butter them. Pile everything onto 4 big plates with tomato sauce.
Buck cooks for an army, then makes the kids eat it all week

Beef ragù layered with pasta sheets, white sauce and mozzarella, baked until bubbling, with a garden salad. Brown the mince in the oil, add the onion and garlic, then the passata, and simmer. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Heat the oven to 180°C. Layer the ragù, pasta and white sauce in a dish, finishing with sauce and mozzarella. Bake until golden and bubbling, then rest. Serve with the lettuce and tomato.
Two smashed beef patties, bacon and cheddar in a toasted bun

Two smashed beef patties with cheddar and crispy bacon in a toasted bun with burger sauce, pickles and onion, served with a stack of napkins. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls and smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, top each with cheddar and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Toast 4 burger buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties, bacon, pickles and diced onion in each.
Rabbit's first week chicken pot pie
Rabbit's a rookie, so Rabbit brings dinner

Chicken, carrot, peas and thyme in a creamy sauce under a puff pastry lid, with buttered green beans. Brown the chicken in half the butter, add the onion and carrot and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream and thyme, simmer until thick, then add the peas. Heat the oven to 200°C. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with pastry and brush with egg. Bake until golden. Boil the beans and toss with the rest of the butter.
they finally make it home for Thanksgiving
Turkey breast brined and roasted at 170C to 70C, sliced, in soft slider buns with cranberry sauce, a square of baked stuffing and a spoon of gravy.
Del's Wichita fried chicken and mash
Del knows a place in every town between Wichita and Chicago

Crumbed chicken breast fried golden, with creamy mash, peppery white gravy and buttered green beans. Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with half the butter and 100ml milk. Dust the chicken in flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in panko. Fry until golden and cooked through. Melt the rest of the butter in the pan, stir in 2 tbsp of the flour, then whisk in the rest of the milk and the pepper for the gravy. Boil the beans and serve with the chicken, mash and gravy.
2 large chicken breasts, halved and flattened@Meat
a big night in for the lottery winner in his new apartment

Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the beef and pork mince, egg, parmesan for the meatballs, the crushed garlic and half the salt. Roll into 20 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil in a wide pan and lift out. Soften the onion and sauce garlic in the pan, add the passata, the basil stalks and the rest of the salt, return the meatballs and simmer. Meanwhile cook 400g spaghetti in well salted boiling water until al dente and drain. Toss the spaghetti with a little sauce, top with the meatballs, torn basil leaves and the parmesan for serving.
Kat Jennings' Route 23 chicken caesar wraps
Kat's on the phone the whole way down Route 23

Grilled chicken, crisp cos, bacon, parmesan and creamy caesar dressing rolled in soft wraps, with cherry tomatoes and cucumber on the side. Mix the mayonnaise, a squeeze of lemon, garlic, mustard and half the parmesan for the dressing. Rub the chicken with oil and salt and grill until cooked, then rest and slice. Fry the bacon until crisp. Toss the cos with the dressing and the rest of the parmesan. Fill the wraps with the lettuce, chicken and crumbled bacon, roll tight and halve. Serve with tomatoes and cucumber.
Sage thyme butter turkey, mash, green beans and cranberry sauce

Herb-butter roast turkey breast with buttery mash, sage gravy, garlic green beans and a spoon of cranberry sauce. Mash 60g soft butter with chopped sage, thyme and 1 crushed garlic clove and push it under the skin of a 1.5kg turkey breast. Roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes, then rest 15 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 400ml chicken stock and simmer to a gravy. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with garlic butter. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Easter Parade honey glazed ham with spring greens
Easter at the inn, the night Jim and Linda dance to Easter Parade

A small leg ham studded with cloves and glazed with honey and mustard, with buttered new potatoes, asparagus and peas. Heat the oven to 180°C. Score the ham skin in diamonds, stud with cloves and brush with the honey, mustard and sugar. Bake, basting a few times, until glossy and hot through. Boil the potatoes until tender. Cook the asparagus and peas and toss everything with butter. Slice the ham to serve.
1.5kg half leg ham, on the bone@Meat
cooked low at the end of a day in the dirt

Brown 800g diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp oil. Soften 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano and 2 tbsp chopped chipotle in adobo, then a 400g tin of tomatoes and 500ml beef stock. Simmer covered for 2 hours, add a 400g tin of kidney beans and 20g dark chocolate and simmer 20 minutes more. Serve over 300g steamed rice with sour cream, grated cheddar and spring onion.
Adrian's chicken cacciatore with soft polenta
From Rocky's restaurant in Philly, the one named for Adrian

Chicken thighs braised with tomato, capsicum, olives, rosemary and garlic, over soft parmesan polenta. Brown the chicken in the oil, then lift out. Soften the onion, capsicum and garlic in the pan. Add the tomatoes, olives and rosemary, put the chicken back and simmer covered until tender. Bring the stock to the boil, whisk in the polenta and stir until thick, then beat in the parmesan. Serve with the chicken.
Beale Street dry rub pork ribs with slaw
Memphis after dark, the clubs on Beale Street
Memphis style ribs: pork ribs in a paprika and brown sugar dry rub, slow-baked, then finished with a vinegar mop, with creamy slaw and white bread.
Graceland meatloaf with mash and gravy
Elvis's favourite at home, cooked in the Graceland kitchen

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sweet tomato glaze, creamy mash, onion gravy and buttered peas. Heat the oven to 180°C. Mix the mince, onion, egg and breadcrumbs, press into a loaf tin and spread with the tomato sauce mixed with sugar. Bake until cooked through, then rest. Boil the potatoes and mash with half the butter and the milk. Stir the flour into the loaf tin juices with the stock and simmer for gravy. Cook the peas and serve.
Matera orecchiette with broccolini and anchovy
dinner in the old stone town before everything goes wrong

Toast 60g fresh breadcrumbs in a tbsp of olive oil. Boil 400g orecchiette for 8 minutes, adding 500g chopped broccolini for the last 4. Meanwhile melt 6 anchovies with 4 sliced garlic cloves and a tsp of chilli flakes in the rest of the oil. Toss in the pasta and broccolini with a splash of pasta water, 40g pecorino and a lemon's zest and top with the crumbs.
Port Antonio jerk chicken with rice and peas
Bond's retirement in Jamaica, before Felix comes knocking

Chicken marinated in Scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme and spring onion, grilled until charred, with coconut rice and kidney beans and a slaw. Blitz the spring onion, chilli, allspice, thyme leaves, soy and lime juice and rub over the chicken. Grill or roast at 200°C until charred and cooked through. Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, 250ml water and salt, covered, until tender. Serve with the shredded cabbage.
takeaway eaten on the motel bed while Sam and Richie lie low
Two thin beef patties smashed on a very hot pan, with melted cheese, onion, pickles and burger sauce on toasted soft buns.
Mindy explains the rules of a requel while the pizza goes cold

Crisp-based pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni, red onion and chilli flakes, with a rocket salad. Heat the oven to 240°C with the trays inside. Spread the bases with passata and oregano, then top with mozzarella, pepperoni and onion. Bake until crisp and bubbling. Scatter with chilli flakes and serve with rocket dressed with oil.
Slow-simmered beef chilli with cumin and chilli powder

Beef mince and kidney beans simmered with chipotle, cumin and dark chocolate until thick and smoky, topped with sour cream, cheddar and pickled jalapeño. Brown 800g beef mince in a heavy pot. Add 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then 2 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp chilli powder and 1 tbsp chipotle in adobo. Stir in 800g tinned tomatoes, 300ml beef stock and 20g dark chocolate and simmer 45 minutes. Add 2 drained 400g tins kidney beans for the last 15 minutes. Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar, pickled jalapeños and crusty bread.
Après ski at the lodge, 1986, before anyone touches the future

Crumbed chicken schnitzel fried golden, with warm potato salad, lemon and a cucumber dill salad. Boil the potatoes until tender, then toss warm with the mayonnaise and mustard. Dust the chicken in flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in panko. Fry until golden and cooked through. Toss the cucumber with chopped dill and lemon juice and serve with the schnitzel and lemon wedges.
2 large chicken breasts, halved and flattened@Meat
Potatoes, corn, shrimp and mussels boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, garlic butter
Prawns, mussels, corn and potatoes boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, tipped onto paper with melted butter.
Tortuga jerk chicken with rice and peas
Recruiting a crew in the Tortuga tavern, Gibbs doing the talking

Chicken thighs in a Scotch bonnet, allspice and thyme marinade, charred on the grill, with coconut rice and kidney beans. Blitz the spring onion, chilli, allspice, thyme leaves, soy and lime juice and rub over the chicken. Grill or roast at 200°C until charred and cooked through. Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, 250ml water and salt, covered, until tender.

S: Red lentil and tomato soup in mugs, grilled cheese fingers to dunk
Tomato and red lentil soup simmered with onion, garlic and cumin, blended smooth, served in mugs with grilled cheese fingers.
Crisp fried Filipino spring rolls filled with seasoned pork and carrot

Thin, crackling Filipino spring rolls packed with pork, carrot and garlic, fried golden and served with sweet chilli and vinegar dipping sauces. Mix 400g pork mince with 1 grated carrot, 1 finely diced onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 egg, 1 tbsp soy sauce and pepper. Lay 20 spring roll wrappers out one at a time, put a thin line of filling along one edge, fold in the sides and roll tightly, sealing with water. Fry at 175C for 5 minutes until deep golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and vinegar mixed with garlic.
Peter's usual from Delmar's deli, pressed down real flat

Turkey, Swiss cheese and pickles in a hero roll with mustard and mayo, pressed flat in a hot pan and cut into pieces to share. Split the rolls and spread with mustard and mayonnaise. Fill with turkey, cheese and pickles. Butter the outside and press in a hot pan under a heavy pan, turning once, until crisp and melted. Cut into pieces to share.

M: Scrooge's prize turkey with sage stuffing
Butter roast turkey breast with sage and onion stuffing

Butter-roasted turkey breast with sage and onion stuffing, apple sauce, roast potatoes and a rich gravy, a feast for the Cratchits. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast with 40g butter, salt and pepper and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Mix 150g breadcrumbs, 1 diced onion fried in 30g butter, 2 tbsp chopped sage and 1 egg, press into a dish and bake for the last 30 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil alongside. Simmer 3 peeled diced apples with 2 tbsp sugar and water until soft. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock.
Fred's Christmas party roast beef and Yorkshire puddings
Fred's party, where Scrooge finally turns up for dinner

Beef sirloin roasted pink, with puffed Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes, glazed carrots and gravy. Heat the oven to 220°C. Whisk the eggs, flour and milk into a batter and rest. Season the beef, sear it, then roast with the potatoes and carrots tossed in half the oil until pink inside. Rest the beef. Turn the oven to 230°C, heat the rest of the oil in a muffin tin, pour in the batter and bake until puffed. Stir the extra flour and stock into the roasting tin juices and simmer for gravy. Glaze the carrots with honey.
Rump strips and mushrooms in creamy sauce over egg noodles

Seared beef strips and mushrooms in a creamy paprika, mustard and sour cream sauce, over buttery egg noodles with dill. Slice 600g rump into thin strips and sear in batches in a hot pan with oil for 1 minute. Remove. Fry 1 sliced onion and 300g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter for 6 minutes. Add 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tbsp Dijon and 300ml beef stock and simmer 3 minutes. Stir in 200g sour cream and the beef and warm through without boiling. Cook 400g egg noodles, toss in butter and dill and serve under the beef.
Bunnymund's Aussie lamb chops with minted peas
Bunny's from Down Under, and he won't let you forget it

Lamb loin chops charred on the barbecue with garlic and rosemary, with crushed minted peas and crispy roast potatoes. Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and salt and roast until crisp. Rub the chops with garlic, chopped rosemary and the rest of the oil. Grill the chops on a hot barbecue or pan until charred and pink inside, then rest. Boil the peas, then crush with the butter, chopped mint and a squeeze of lemon.
Winston the ogre's beef and barley stew
Chuck steak, carrot, mushroom and barley stew

A big pot of slow-braised beef with barley, carrots and mushrooms in a rich gravy, served with crusty bread and horseradish butter. Toss 1kg diced chuck steak in 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches in oil. Add 1 diced onion, 2 carrots, 200g mushrooms and 2 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1.2L beef stock, 100g pearl barley and 2 bay leaves. Simmer covered for 2 hours until the beef is tender. Mash 60g butter with 1 tbsp horseradish cream and serve with a crusty loaf.
King Agamemnon's slow-roast lamb with lemon potatoes
Agamemnon wants Kevin to stay in ancient Greece for good

Lamb shoulder roasted low with garlic, oregano and lemon until it falls apart, with lemony potatoes and a Greek salad. Heat the oven to 160°C. Stud the lamb with garlic and rub with oregano, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp oil and salt. Roast covered in a deep tray with the stock until falling apart. Add the potatoes tossed in lemon juice and oil, uncover and roast at 200°C until golden. Toss the tomato, cucumber, feta and olives with the last of the oil and serve with the lamb.
Tomato fish stew with white fish, prawns and potato, garlic toast

Chunks of white fish and prawns in a smoky tomato, potato and paprika broth, served with garlic toast for dunking. Fry 1 diced onion, 1 diced capsicum and 2 garlic cloves in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp smoked paprika, 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 500ml fish stock and 400g diced potatoes and simmer 15 minutes. Add 500g firm white fish chunks and 200g peeled green prawns and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in parsley. Rub toasted sourdough with garlic and serve alongside.
Billy Bones' Benbow Inn steak and mushroom pie
Billy Bones never paid for a single one

Chuck steak and mushrooms slow-cooked in a rich gravy under a puff pastry lid, with mushy peas. Toss the beef in the flour and brown in the oil, then add the onion and mushrooms. Add the stock and Worcestershire and simmer covered until tender. Cool a little. Heat the oven to 200°C. Spoon into a pie dish, cover with pastry and brush with egg. Bake until golden. Boil the peas and roughly mash with the butter.
Crab pieces in a sweet chilli tomato sauce with egg ribbons, crusty bread to mop up
Crab cooked in a sticky sweet chilli tomato sauce with egg ribbons, eaten with bread to mop up.
Nine pirate lords at one table in Shipwreck Cove, and nobody agrees

Chicken poached with ginger and spring onion, with rice cooked in the stock, cucumber, chilli sauce and ginger spring onion oil. Poach the chicken in water with half the ginger, 2 spring onions and salt at a gentle simmer, then cool in ice water. Fry 2 crushed garlic cloves in the oil, add the rice and 600ml of the poaching stock and cook covered. Blitz the chillies with the rest of the garlic, a little ginger and lime juice. Pour hot oil over the rest of the ginger and spring onion, finely chopped. Slice the chicken and serve with the rice, cucumber, coriander, soy and both sauces.

S: Passed round the deck while nobody notices Bernie

Halved eggs with a creamy mustard and paprika yolk filling, topped with chives and crisp shallots. Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel. Halve the eggs and mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard and salt. Pipe the filling back into the whites. Dust with paprika and top with chives and crispy shallots.
Chopped clams folded into cream cheese and sour cream, with potato chips
Chopped clams folded through cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and chives, with potato chips.
Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, glazed with soy, brown sugar and ginger
Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, brushed with soy, brown sugar and ginger, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.
W: Buttery sponge baked over caramelised pineapple rings and cherries, flipped out
Brown sugar and butter in the tin, pineapple rings and cherries on top, butter cake batter poured over, baked at 175C for 45 minutes, flipped.

M: Lemon chilli grilled chicken, chapati and tomato kachumbari salad

Chilli, lemon and garlic marinated chicken thighs grilled with char, served with soft pan-fried chapati and a fresh tomato and red onion kachumbari. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets with the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. For chapati, mix 300g plain flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil and 180ml warm water, knead and rest 20 minutes, then roll into 8 rounds and dry-fry 1 minute a side. Grill the chicken 6 minutes a side. Toss 3 diced tomatoes, 1 red onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari.
Wachootoo sweet potato and peanut stew
Brought to the peace feast between the Wachati and the Wachootoo

Sweet potato, tomato and spinach simmered in a spiced peanut sauce, over rice with lime and roasted peanuts. Soften the onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and cumin in the oil. Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, peanut butter and stock and simmer until tender. Meanwhile cook the rice. Stir through the spinach until wilted. Serve over rice with lime and chopped peanuts.
Palmyra grilled lobster tails with Bahamian baked macaroni
Largo's terrace, with the sharks circling in the pool below

Cook 300g macaroni until almost done. Whisk 2 eggs, a tin of evaporated milk, 200g grated tasty cheese, diced capsicum and onion, cayenne, salt, pepper and 20g melted butter, stir in the pasta, top with 50g more cheese and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Melt 80g butter with 3 garlic cloves, a lime's zest and juice and paprika. Split 4 lobster tails lengthways, brush with the butter and grill for 6 to 8 minutes, basting, until just opaque. Serve with the macaroni and parsley.
4 raw lobster tails, or 8 Moreton Bay bugs@Seafood
Junkanoo stew chicken with peas and rice
The night of the Junkanoo parade Bond runs through in Nassau

Bahamian brown stew chicken with thyme, allspice, capsicum and tomato, with pigeon pea rice and fried plantain. Melt the sugar in 1 tbsp oil until dark, then brown the chicken in it. Add the onion, capsicum, garlic, allspice, thyme, tomato paste and 300ml water and simmer covered until tender. Cook the rice with the peas, 600ml water and salt, covered, until tender. Fry the sliced plantain in the rest of the oil and serve with the chicken and rice.
400g tin pigeon peas or kidney beans, drained@Pantry
Grilled rump with parsley chimichurri, corn, sausages and apple slaw

Chargrilled rump steak and pork sausages with a sharp herb chimichurri, served with grilled corn and a crunchy apple slaw. Blitz 1 bunch parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning. Grill 8 pork sausages for 12 minutes. Season 800g rump steak and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice. Toss shredded cabbage and 1 julienned apple with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and lemon. Spoon chimichurri over the steak.
Robert De Niro party chicken parm heroes
Delta Psi's De Niro night, everyone in a mole and a sneer

Crumbed chicken fried crisp, baked under napoli sauce and mozzarella in toasted hero rolls, with a rocket salad. Heat the oven to 200°C. Dust the chicken in flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in panko. Fry until golden and cooked through. Lay in the split rolls, spoon over the napoli, top with mozzarella and bake until melted. Serve with rocket and parmesan.
2 large chicken breasts, halved and flattened@Meat
Roast chicken, pigs in blankets, roast potatoes, maple sprouts, gravy

Roast chicken with pigs in blankets, crunchy roast potatoes, maple-glazed Brussels sprouts with bacon and plenty of gravy. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Wrap 12 chipolatas in half rashers of streaky bacon and add for the last 30 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil for 50 minutes. Halve 400g Brussels sprouts and fry with 2 diced rashers bacon for 6 minutes, then toss with 1 tbsp maple syrup. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 350ml chicken stock.
Oakmoor School's posh salmon en croûte
Mr Shakespeare's posh rival school does a very fancy nativity

Salmon fillet wrapped with spinach and herbed cream cheese in golden puff pastry, with buttered new potatoes and green beans. Heat the oven to 200°C. Wilt the spinach and squeeze dry. Mix the cream cheese with chopped dill and lemon zest. Lay the salmon on the pastry, spread with the cream cheese and spinach, wrap and brush with egg. Bake until golden. Boil the potatoes at the same time. Boil the beans and toss the beans and potatoes with butter. Slice the salmon to serve.
stockpiled for forty years and cooked in the compound kitchen
Chunky beef chuck chilli with chipotle, black beans and tomato, slow-simmered and served with sour cream, cheddar, lime and corn chips.
Strode family dinner roast chicken and pumpkin
The awkward family dinner where Laurie turns up anyway

Lemon and thyme roast chicken with roast pumpkin, red onion and potatoes, pan gravy and a green salad. Heat the oven to 200°C. Stuff the chicken with the halved lemon and thyme, rub with oil and salt. Roast the chicken with the vegetables tossed in oil until golden and cooked through. Rest the chicken. Stir the flour and stock into the tray juices and simmer for gravy. Carve and serve with the vegetables, gravy and salad.
Winifred's cauldron beef and pumpkin stew with herb dumplings
the sisters' cauldron bubbling away in the old cottage

Slow-simmered beef with carrots and butternut pumpkin in a thick thyme gravy, with fluffy parsley dumplings steamed on top. Toss 1kg cubed beef chuck in 2 tbsp seasoned plain flour and brown in batches in 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot, then lift out. Soften 1 chopped brown onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 2 carrots in the pot, stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, then add 1 litre beef stock, 2 bay leaves and 1 tsp dried thyme. Return the beef, cover and simmer gently for 1 1/2 hours. Add 600g butternut pumpkin chunks and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. Rub 60g cold butter into 200g self-raising flour with 2 tbsp chopped parsley and a pinch of salt, stir in 150ml milk and roll into 8 balls. Sit them on the stew, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until puffed. Season and serve 2 dumplings to a bowl.
Becca's birthday pumpkin and sage mac and cheese
Becca's sixteenth, the night the Black Flame Candle gets lit

Macaroni baked in a roast pumpkin and cheddar sauce with crisp sage and a golden crumb top. Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the pumpkin in half the oil until soft, then mash. Boil the macaroni until just short of done and drain. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk until thick, then add the pumpkin and most of the cheddar. Fold in the pasta, tip into a dish and top with the rest of the cheddar, crumbs and sage leaves tossed in the last of the oil. Bake until golden.
Maria's pernil with arroz con gandules
Sunday dinner in the apartment off the fire escape
Puerto Rican slow-roast pork shoulder, marinated overnight in garlic, oregano and citrus and roasted until the skin crackles, over yellow sofrito rice with pigeon peas and green olives.
Officer Krupke's corned beef and cabbage
Gee, Officer Krupke, the Jets' favourite cop gets his dinner

Corned silverside simmered with onion, cloves and peppercorns, with buttered cabbage, carrots, potatoes and hot mustard. Cover the beef with water, add the onion, peppercorns, sugar and vinegar and simmer gently. Add the carrots and potatoes for the last part of cooking. Steam the cabbage wedges until tender and toss with butter. Slice the beef and serve with the vegetables and mustard.
